header.superHtml:
Ready to upgrade your brushing routine? The SuperMouth 4-Flavor Fluoride Toothpaste Variety Bundle lets you sample every delicious flavor—at an exclusive discount. Like an ice cream shop for your smile, you and your family can find your favorite toothpaste flavor, then match it across all our consumables, including mouthwashes, flosses, and mouth sprays, for a fully coordinated and flavorful oral care experience!


Our fluoride toothpastes, expertly formulated for all ages, combine cavity-fighting fluoride with Hydroxamin—our patented Liquid Enamel Technology featuring at least 10% nano-hydroxyapatite, vitamin D3, and K2—to strengthen enamel and help reduce sensitivity. Crafted for a healthy mouth, they provide long-lasting protection and fresh breath with every brush.

  • Xylitol-Enriched: Helps maintain moisture and promotes a balanced oral environment.

  • Prebiotic Support: Enriched with inulin and other prebiotics to nurture beneficial microbes while selectively reducing harmful ones, promoting overall oral health.
  • Alkaline pH: Maintains an optimal pH balance to support a healthy oral environment and combat acid attacks.
  • Low RDA Value: With a Relative Dentin Abrasivity (RDA) of 67, this toothpaste is safe for daily use, offering effective cleaning without damaging enamel.
  • No Artificial Additives: Free from artificial flavors, colors, sweeteners, preservatives, SLS, and antibiotics; non-GMO.
  • Long-Lasting Protection: Offers a durable coat that protects teeth even after brushing, ensuring prolonged effectiveness.
  • Safe & Clean Ingredients: Formulated with pure and effective ingredients for a clean brushing experience.
  • Gentle Whitening: Helps to naturally whiten teeth, restoring their natural brightness.
  • Global Quality: Made in the USA with premium, globally sourced ingredients.
  • Inclusive Formulation: Gluten-free and paraben-free to cater to all users.

items.title: FAQs
items.html:
Can I buy a single flavor once I discover my favorite?
Absolutely! Once you know which flavor your family loves most, feel free to purchase it individually—or explore it in our mouthwash, floss, or mouth spray, too.
Is this bundle suitable for both children and adults?
Yes! Our formulations are crafted for all ages—delicious for kids, powerful for grown-ups.
Why do some people choose fluoride toothpaste?
Fluoride toothpaste is chosen for its proven ability to prevent cavities and strengthen enamel. Fluoride is recognized by the FDA for its cavity prevention benefits and its ability to fortify teeth against decay. It’s especially recommended for individuals at higher risk of cavities.
What is fluoride toothpaste?
Fluoride toothpaste contains fluoride, a mineral that helps prevent tooth decay by making the tooth enamel more resistant to acid attacks from plaque bacteria and sugars in the mouth. SuperMouth’s Hydroxamin with fluoride toothpaste also includes nano-hydroxyapatite, providing comprehensive protection and remineralization.
What is nano-hydroxyapatite in oral care products?
Nano-hydroxyapatite is a naturally occurring mineral similar to human tooth enamel. It’s used to promote remineralization, helping to restore and protect the enamel surface of the teeth. SuperMouth uses at least 10% nano-hydroxyapatite in all our toothpastes, ensuring enhanced penetration and effectiveness.
How do fluoride and nano-hydroxyapatite work together?
Fluoride and nano-hydroxyapatite work synergistically to provide superior oral health benefits. Fluoride strengthens enamel and helps prevent cavities, while nano-hydroxyapatite promotes enamel remineralization, reduces sensitivity, and offers natural whitening. Together, they create a robust defense against tooth decay and enamel erosion.
What other ingredients are in SuperMouth’s Hydroxamin with fluoride toothpaste?
Our toothpaste contains prebiotics like inulin and xylitol to promote a healthy oral microbiome. We avoid essential oils like peppermint, eucalyptus, and tea tree oils, which can disrupt the oral microbiome. Additionally, we use no artificial colors, flavors, sweeteners, or preservatives, and all our ingredients are ranked a #1 on the EWG scale for safety.
What is Hydroxamin in SuperMouth products?
Hydroxamin is SuperMouth’s unique formulation combining nano-hydroxyapatite, vitamin D3, and vitamin K2, along with fluoride. Nano-hydroxyapatite supports enamel by mimicking natural tooth minerals. Vitamin D3 assists in healthy development of teeth and bones, and vitamin K2 ensures proper calcium utilization. This balanced blend ensures each ingredient is at the right concentration for maximum efficacy, enhancing overall oral health.

items.title: HOW TO USE
items.html:
• Pick any flavor—from crisp mint to sweet chocolate.
  • Squeeze a pea-sized amount onto your toothbrush.
  • Brush thoroughly for two minutes (before breakfast and before bedtime).
  • Rotate flavors anytime to keep brushing fun—just like sampling new scoops at the ice cream parlor!
  • Feeling adventurous? Mix two flavors for a delicious “ice cream swirl” experience—think chocolate and mint for a refreshing twist!

reviews.title: Best hydroxyapatite toothpaste flavors!

The strawberry and vanilla flavors were offered as a sample which was not over powering and kept my mouth feeling clean. The floss is stellar as it is expanding and I love the pH balanced spray. Using it was fun and made me feel better about exposure times with eating.

I highly recommend this product. It is worth every penny!  You won’t be disappointed.
